# Rian Balan Photography

> Rian Balan is a portrait, couple and personal brand photographer based in London, UK. Sessions use natural light and every package includes posing guidance, so people with no experience in front of the camera feel comfortable.

## Services

- Portrait photography: individual portraits, dating and social media profiles, personal updates.
- Couple photography: love story sessions, engagements and anniversaries.
- Personal brand photography: studio and outdoor sessions for creators and professionals.
- Collaborations with creators, influencers and brands on visual projects.

## Packages and prices (GBP)

The first session is at the standard price. From the second session on, clients pay the founding price.

- Mini Story: 45 minutes, 1 location, 8 edited photos, posing guidance. Standard £235, founding £195.
- Classic Story (most popular): 90 minutes, 1–2 outfits, 1 main location, 20 edited photos, consultation before the session, posing guidance. Standard £285, founding £235.
- Signature Story: 150 minutes, 2 locations or studio and outdoor, 2–3 outfits, 35–40 edited photos, moodboard before the session. Standard £405, founding £325.

Photos are edited by hand and delivered in an online gallery.
